notes:
Summary: Montara builds a knowledge-base product for midsize SaaS customers (support KB + internal docs). Primary objective is a hosted RAG pipeline: dense embeddings for retrieval + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-k. They estimate a moderate index size (1-5M active docs initially, likely 5-12M within 12 months) and very high QPS during business hours (sustained 150-400 qps peak, burst to 1k qps).

Requirements: p95 latency for user-facing queries <= 120ms end-to-end (retrieve + rerank); cost target ~ $0.002 - $0.01 per query (depending on rerank depth). Strong cost sensitivity because Montara bills customers per-query and needs predictable margins. They prefer hosted API to avoid operational burden but require SSO + audit logs and KMS-backed keying.

Technical preferences/architecture discussed: ANN index (HNSW or IVF+PQ) for global retrieval, sharded vector index to handle QPS, prefix KV caching for hot queries, and a small cross-encoder (quantized) to rerank top-20. Want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant in heavy load. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization profiles.

POC notes: Initial ingest of 1.2M docs completed. SE (Priya) observed average retrieval latency 30-45ms, cross-encoder rerank median 60ms on hosted small cross-encoder; end-to-end median ~120ms, p95 ~220ms due to CPU-bound cross-encoder during spikes. Action: try smaller reranker or run re-rank in a GPU-backed tier; test automatic rerank-only on top-5 candidate path.

Quote from CTO (Ravi): "We need a predictable bill and predictable tail latency — can't have 2x cost surprises during support surges."

Links and artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive. Jira RWD-1189 open for quota/perf tuning. Gmail threads contain the SAML metadata exchange. Fireflies for the 2026-02-03 deep-dive.

Sales signal: strong product fit for hosted API + Optimize; potential expansion into Dedicated once ARR > $150k and latency/p95 improves.

Next steps (short): SE to validate sharded index config (due 2026-03-15); engineering sync to evaluate cross-encoder GPU option; finalize pricing scenario for sustained 300 qps tier.
routing_and_fallback_needs: Prefer policy-based routing: primary hosted cheaper model -> fallback to GPU-backed reranker; automatic degrade to top-5 rerank in overload
notes_short: High-QPS SaaS KB vendor. Hosted API preference, cost-sensitive, needs SAML + audit logs. POC shows mid p95 issues from reranker; evaluating GPU rerank or reduced depth to meet SLOs.
sales_playbook_tips: Highlight Redwood Optimize for batching & quantization; propose staged pricing (sustained qps tiers) and a canary rollout for rerank configs. Offer a 30-day discount for early Dedicated commit.
closing_signals: Budget holder expressed willingness to sign if p95 < 120ms at 300 qps and pricing predictable; indicated procurement review starting 2026-03-20
